chunks: Ibn Muskan narrated from Abū Baṣīr, from someone who asked him; he said:
I said to him: A man bequeathed twenty dinars for a hajj. He said: “A man should perform hajj with it from wherever it suffices for him.”

key_terms.أَوْصَى: he made a bequest in his will
key_terms.حَجَّةٍ: a hajj, the pilgrimage intended by the bequest
key_terms.يَبْلُغُهُ: it reaches or suffices for him

ai.seo_question: If a person bequeaths an amount insufficient for a full hajj journey, from where should the hajj be performed?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a bequest set aside for hajj when the amount is limited. It indicates that the hajj is to be carried out from the point that the available sum can cover, rather than requiring departure from a place beyond its financial reach.
